text: 9月11日，工业和信息化部举行新闻发布会，介绍我国智能网联新能源汽车产业发展有关情况。工业和信息化部装备工业一司司长郭守刚在会上表示，下一步，工业和信息化部将稳妥有序做好驾驶辅助和自动驾驶相关强制性国家标准的落地实施，优化准入管理制度，持续强化安全监管，保障产业安全有序发展。稳妥推进准入试点。持续开展智能网联汽车生产准入和上路通行试点，稳妥推进高速领航、自动泊车及物流配送等场景拓展，支持企业加强实践探索，同时加强经验总结，支撑相关法律法规、技术标准制修订。（证券时报）
text_en: On September 11, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology held a press conference to brief on the development of China's intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry. Guo Shougang, director of the First Equipment Industry Department of MIIT, said at the meeting that next, MIIT will steadily and orderly implement mandatory national standards related to driver assistance and autonomous driving, optimize the access management system, and continuously strengthen safety supervision to ensure the safe and orderly development of the industry. Steadily advance access pilots. Continue to carry out production access and road operation pilots for intelligent connected vehicles, steadily advance expansion into scenarios such as highway navigation, automated parking, and logistics delivery, support enterprises in strengthening practical exploration, and at the same time strengthen experience summarization to support the formulation and revision of relevant laws, regulations, and technical standards. (Securities Times)
